title: 第一章 神武县中
slug: 盛唐风华全本免费-盛唐风华最新章节列表
content_zh:
神武县东门之外，几名鹰扬兵正站在城门口左近，懒洋洋的闲谈。
神武县是桑干河流域的一个小县城，战国时候属赵，汉朝元狩年间才设立县治，几近废县重设之后，在本朝成为马邑郡治下。
哪怕在已经被认为偏僻所在的马邑郡，神武县都不是什么起眼的所在。郡治在西南面善阳，而冲要更不如北面的天下名镇云内。唯一所长，大概就是在马邑郡中，神武县位于桑干河流域，算是郡中较为富庶的所在了。
自从大业初年边事败坏以来，神武县城防也得到了修葺，城墙上到处可以看到新鲜夯土的颜色，经历几个冬天如刀寒风吹过之后，城墙夯土不论新旧已经坚如铁石。
城墙之外，壕沟，羊马墙，一应俱全。还有遮护城门的小型堡垒。而在城墙上的防御设施也是一应俱全。
门口几名鹰扬兵虽然懒洋洋的在谈笑，身上军袍也敝旧不堪，这军容比之内地鹰扬府的郡兵差远了，可自有一种强悍之气。
隋承北周精兵，设有十二卫。数十万精锐皆是百战之师，开皇天子靠着这十二卫精兵压服了整个天下，北面突厥更是不敢南下弯弓。
而十二卫精兵来源，就是各郡设立的鹰扬府，府兵平时务农，农闲时候操练或者服官府各种役务，临战征召起来作为大隋精锐以讨不臣。
全大隋一百二十七个鹰扬府，属于马邑郡的马邑鹰扬府和恒安鹰扬府正是天下闻名的云中精兵。
此间临近草原，几百年来都是和胡族打生打死，十几岁的少年就骑得烈马，开得硬弓。乡间侠少在各村争水的时候都是骑马对冲。
两府的鹰扬兵，大业五年的时候雁门郡勤王天子，后来又加入了数次征高丽的血战中，这几年突厥势大，马邑的鹰扬兵更是在马邑太守王仁恭的带领下屡次上阵，战功累累。
比起内地破败不堪的军府，马邑鹰扬兵还保有大隋精兵的一些旧日模样。
几个鹰扬兵不知道聊着什么，正说得口沫横飞，指手画脚，不时发出一阵哄笑声。引得城墙上巡卒都在探头探脑。
热闹声中，就听见蹄声响动，几名巡卒朝城门内望去。忙不迭的就跳了开去：“那世家子来了！”
蹄声杂沓声中，城门口烟尘斗乱。一队又一队的马军开了出来，足有一二百人的规模。
这些骑士人人赤色军袍鲜明，一人双马，马鞍后还放着甲包，一副精锐模样，经过城门时，对那些军袍敝旧的门兵看都不看一眼，下巴快昂到了天上去。
而队伍当中，正正拱卫着一名三十许的将领，穿着大袖襦衣，大口侉裤，但却带着璞头而不是武将惯着介帻，有些不伦不类。手中持着一柄铁如意，唇上短髯被上了油抹得上翘，这又是晋阳城中世家子的模样。
烟尘之中，这一二百骑穿过城门，向东而去。
隋朝鹰扬府制度，一团数营不等，营分越骑射声长水中垒之名，每营下辖二旅至三旅不等，每旅二队，每队五火，每火十人。
这一二百骑正是一个以越骑为名的骑兵营建制。

马邑郡有左屯卫马邑鹰扬府和右屯卫恒安鹰扬府两支鹰扬兵建制。鹰扬兵平时务农，战时成军。马邑郡为边塞之地，直面突厥，纵然是平时保留的鹰扬兵比内地郡府为多，但这一营装备完全，人人双马的越骑鹰扬兵也是郡中主力之一了。
二百骑卷起的烟尘未散，门兵们都直起腰来，人人脸上都是不以为然之色。
一名门兵摇头：“太守将压箱底的队伍都一支支拿出来了，这是非要压得刘鹰击低头啊。”
另一名门兵也摇头：“这些时日过了多少人马了？马邑鹰扬兵至少有一半去了云中，这下刘鹰击怎么也要去善阳了。”
一个三十多岁的鹰扬兵许是在军中日久，听得的内幕消息比较多，摸着胡子若有所思：“本来咱们马邑郡就是王太守的天下，天子派刘鹰击回来分权做什么？王太守是琅琊王家出身，几百年的大族，怎么瞧得上刘鹰击这么个厮杀汉？这马邑郡中，只能有一个人说了算，王太守自然是当仁不让。”
管着城门口的火长听得烦恼，怒道：“现在突厥人都压到云中北面了，还在闹个不休！到时候突厥人打进来大家都干净！入娘的，这日子是没法过了！”
几个鹰扬兵也跟着叹气，同声附和。

content_en:
Outside the east gate of Shenwu County, several Yingyang soldiers were standing near the city gate, chatting lazily.
Shenwu County is a small county in the Sanggan River Basin. It belonged to Zhao during the Warring States Period. The county government was not established until the Yuanshou Period of the Han Dynasty. After the county was almost abolished and re-established, it became the jurisdiction of Mayi County in this dynasty.
Even in Mayi County, which is already considered a remote location, Shenwu County is not an eye-catching place. The county government is located in Shanyang in the southwest, and its strategic location is not as good as Yunnei, a famous town in the world to the north. The only strong point is probably that in Mayi County, Shenwu County is located in the Sanggan River Basin, which is considered a relatively prosperous place in the county.
Since the corruption of the border affairs in the early years of Daye, the city defenses of Shenwu County have also been repaired. The color of fresh rammed earth can be seen everywhere on the city walls. After several winters, the rammed earth of the city walls has become as strong as iron stone, regardless of whether it is old or new.
Outside the city wall, there are trenches, sheep and horse walls, and everything else. There are also small fortresses that protect the city gates. The defensive facilities on the city wall are also fully equipped.
Although several Yingyang soldiers at the door were chatting and laughing lazily, and their military robes were in tatters. Their military appearance was far inferior to that of the county soldiers in Yingyang Mansion inside, but they had a strong aura about them.
The Sui Dynasty inherited the elite troops of the Northern Zhou Dynasty and had twelve guards. Hundreds of thousands of elites are all capable of hundreds of battles. The Emperor Kaihuang subdued the entire world with the help of these twelve elite soldiers, and the Turks in the north did not dare to bend their bows southward.
The source of the elite soldiers of the Twelve Guards was the Yingyang Mansion set up in each county. The soldiers of the government worked in farming during the day, and during the off-farm time they practiced or served in various government services. They were recruited in times of war as the elites of the Sui Dynasty to fight against unruly ministers.
There are one hundred and twenty-seven Yingyang Mansion in the Sui Dynasty. The Mayi Yingyang Mansion and Hengan Yingyang Mansion belonging to Mayi County are world-famous Yunzhong Elite Soldiers.
This place is close to the grassland. For hundreds of years, they have been fighting to the death with the Hu people. The teenagers can ride strong horses and shoot strong bows. When villagers compete for water, they always ride horses to compete for water.
The Ying Yang Bing of the two prefectures, Emperor Qin of Yanmen County in the fifth year of the Great Cause, later participated in several bloody battles to conquer Goryeo. In recent years, the Turks were gaining momentum, and the Ying Yang Bing of Mayi went into battle many times under the leadership of Wang Rengong, the prefect of Mayi, and made numerous military exploits.
Compared with the dilapidated military mansions in the mainland, Mayi Ying Yangbing still retains some of the old appearance of the elite soldiers of the Sui Dynasty.
The Yingyang soldiers didn't know what they were chatting about. They were frothing at the mouth, gesticulating, and burst into laughter from time to time. The guards on the city wall were all peeping around.
Amidst the excitement, the sound of hoofbeats was heard, and several patrolmen looked towards the city gate. He jumped away in a hurry and said, "The son of that family is here!"
Amidst the clatter of hooves, there was a cloud of smoke and dust at the city gate. Team after team of cavalry troops came out, with a total of one or two hundred people.
Each of these knights wore bright red uniforms, each had two horses, and armor bags were placed behind the saddles. They looked like elites. When they passed the city gate, they didn't even look at the guards with worn uniforms, and their chins were raised to the sky.
Among the troops, there was a general in his thirties guarding him. He was wearing a long-sleeved jacket and wide-mouthed trousers, but he was wearing a plain headband instead of the customary hat worn by generals, which was a bit nondescript. He was holding an iron ruyi in his hand, and his short beard was oiled and turned upwards. He looked like a son of aristocratic family in Jinyang City.
In the smoke and dust, these two hundred riders passed through the city gate and headed east.
In the Yingyang Mansion system of the Sui Dynasty, a regiment had several battalions, and the battalions were named after Yueqi Shesheng and Changshui fortresses. Each battalion had two to three brigades, and each brigade had two teams. Each team had five fires and ten men per fire.
These two hundred cavalry are exactly a cavalry battalion in the name of Yueqi.
Mayi County has two Yingyang army formations: the left Tunwei Mayi Yingyang Mansion and the right Tunwei Heng'an Yingyang Mansion. Ying Yangbing farmed in peacetime and formed an army in wartime. Mayi County is a frontier fortress, facing the Turks. Even though there are usually more Ying Yang soldiers than inland counties, this battalion is fully equipped, and the Yueqi Ying Yang soldiers with each man and two horses are one of the main forces in the county.
The smoke and dust raised by the two hundred cavalry have not dispersed, and the gate soldiersThey all straightened up, with disapproval on their faces.
One of the soldiers shook his head: "The prefect took out all the teams pressing at the bottom of the box one by one. He must suppress Liu Ying's head."
Another soldier also shook his head: "How many troops have passed these days? At least half of Ma Yi Ying Yang's troops went to Yunzhong. Now Liu Yingchang has to go to Shan Yang."
Ying Yangbing, a man in his thirties, probably had been in the army for a long time and had heard a lot of inside information. He stroked his beard and thought thoughtfully: "Originally, our Mayi County was ruled by Governor Wang. The emperor sent Liu Ying to come back to decentralize power. What to do? Taishou Wang is from the Langya Wang family, and he has been a member of a wealthy family for hundreds of years. How can he look down on Liu Yingchou, a warrior like this? There can only be one person who has the final say in Mayi County, so Taishou Wang will naturally do his part."
The fire chief who was in charge of the city gate was troubled when he heard this, and said angrily: "Now the Turks have pressed to the north of Yunzhong, and they are still making trouble! When the Turks come in, everyone will be clean! Damn it, you can't survive this day!"
Several Ying Yang soldiers also sighed and agreed in unison.
